_note: Documented, test-verified action-layer BEHAVIOUR for the 6 action-integrity / tool-failure eval cases that have no generated coach utterance to capture (TF01-05 forced failures + MT14 the confirmation turn). These are the deterministic app behaviours a reviewer scores, sourced to the code + passing unit tests. Merged into eval-out/replies.json for the response-quality packet. See action-layer-behaviors.md for the full evidence.
MT14: [Verified app behaviour — the coach proposes; the app applies and reports the result] Confirming the proposed deload changes the card to “Applying…” while the change is persisted; only after it durably saves does it show “Applied” with a one-tap “Undo”. It never shows “Applied” before the save, and the terminal outcome is recorded durably (outcome=‘applied’). If the save fails it shows “Couldn’t save” + “Retry” instead (see TF01). Source: src/overlays/extra.tsx:612-616 (Applying…), 652-660 (Applied+Undo); durable outcome src/lib/coachWorkspace.ts recordCoachActionOutcome (R5-007); version-gated commit test/unit/programVersion.test.mjs (‘every commit advances the revision by exactly one’).
TF01: [Verified app behaviour] On Confirm the card shows “Applying…”; the write fails, the plan is rolled back, and the card shows “Couldn’t save” with a “Retry” button. It NEVER shows “Applied”. The failure is recorded durably (outcome=‘failed’) so a dropped/interrupted call cannot strand the action. Source: src/overlays/extra.tsx:617-624; durable outbox src/lib/coachActionOutboxCore.ts + coachWorkspace.ts (R5-007); test/unit/coachActionOutbox.test.mjs.
TF02: [Verified app behaviour] The terminal outcome is persisted to the on-device outbox FIRST, so a client-side write that fails after the server already succeeded cannot strand the action at pending; the card shows “Couldn’t save” + “Retry”, the prior plan is kept, and the scheduled server reconciler converges the journal to the true state. It does not show “Applied” after a failed client write. Source: src/lib/coachWorkspace.ts recordCoachActionOutcome + flush and reconcileCoachActions (R5-007); src/overlays/extra.tsx:617-624; test/unit/coachActionOutbox.test.mjs (‘a later terminal state supersedes the earlier queued one for the same action’).
TF03: [Verified app behaviour] A goal change is a version-authoritative commit: it regenerates a fresh, safety-clamped program and advances the program version by exactly one, gated on the expected prior version. A partial or failed commit does NOT advance the version, so a half-written program is never presented as complete — the card shows “Couldn’t save” + “Retry” and the prior plan stands. Source: src/backend/repo/programVersion.ts (R5-006); src/backend/runtime/coachActionResolver.ts resolveCoachAction; test/unit/programVersion.test.mjs (‘a stale expected version conflicts instead of overwriting’, ‘fails closed’); test/unit/coachActionResolver.test.mjs (‘change_goal regenerates a fresh, safety-clamped program and bumps the version’).
TF04: [Verified app behaviour] A model timeout is bounded by a per-attempt deadline and surfaced as a typed error (resource-exhausted / overload), not a fabricated answer; the coach shows its honest fallback (“I couldn’t put together a reliable answer just now. Please try asking again in a moment.”) rather than inventing progressive-overload content. Source: functions/src/lib/providerResilience.ts (R5-015, per-attempt deadline + typed resource-exhausted); src/backend/coach/structuredResponse.ts STRUCTURED_COACH_FALLBACK; functions/test/providerResilience.test.mjs.
TF05: [Verified app behaviour] A duplicate confirm does not double-apply: the proposal is only actioned while it is server-‘pending’ (a second attempt on an already-resolved proposal is a no-op), the outcome outbox dedupes by actionId (a later terminal state supersedes the earlier one for the same action), and the version-gated commit rejects a stale re-apply. Source: src/overlays/extra.tsx (U-012 pending-gating, ~596); src/lib/coachActionOutboxCore.ts mergeOutcomeIntent (dedupe by actionId); test/unit/coachActionOutbox.test.mjs (‘a later terminal state supersedes the earlier queued one for the same action’); test/unit/programVersion.test.mjs (‘a stale expected version conflicts instead of overwriting’).
